tools.name: daily_board
tools.description: The published NBA or WNBA player-prop board for the next slate (player, stat, line, direction, tier, model score) and how the last settled board did (hits, misses, voids). Informational analysis, not betting advice.

tools.name: track_record
tools.description: Settled record of the model's picks with optional filters. Reading it: the overall*/total* fields count every pick the engine evaluated, including Weak ratings that are never published; the published record is the PREMIUM tier (premiumHitRate, goodPicks) and STANDARD (marginalPicks). Dates before 20

tools.name: defense_vs_position
tools.description: How many points, rebounds and assists each team allows to guards, forwards and centers relative to the league average, with defensive rating, opponent pace and ranks.

tools.name: usage_leaders
tools.description: Players ranked by usage rate this season, with last-10-games usage, minutes and points.

tools.name: referee_assignments_today
tools.description: Officiating crew of each NBA game today (published by the league the morning of game day) with each referee's fouls per game.

tools.name: referees
tools.description: All NBA referees this season with games worked, fouls per game and fouls above the league average.

tools.name: nba_today
tools.description: Today's NBA games with tip-off times, yesterday's final scores and the current standings by conference.

tools.name: games
tools.description: NBA and WNBA games on a date (defaults to today, US Eastern).

tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Find NBA and WNBA players by name; returns their ids for player_research.

tools.name: player_research
tools.description: A player's recent game logs, today's prop lines across books with hit rates, injury status, next game context and the model's picks on that player.
